definitions.gloss: the Book of Han, an ancient Chinese history
definitions.explanation: A classic history of China's Former Han dynasty, compiled mainly by Ban Gu in the first century CE. One of the canonical Chinese histories, it is occasionally cited in Japanese as the source of well-known proverbs and phrases.

examples.english: This phrase originates from the Book of Han.

examples.english: The Book of Han is one of China's official histories.

examples.english: In high-school classical-Chinese class, we studied a passage from the Book of Han.

notes:
The title is read かんじょ, not かんしょ. It is a Chinese history of the Former Han ({前漢|ぜんかん}) dynasty.
